description: This PHP source file defines the Notification model class within the Opencart admin module, providing methods for managing notifications in the database such as adding, editing, deleting, retrieving, and counting notifications.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Model class for handling notifications in the administration tool, extending the base Model class of Opencart's engine. It provides CRUD operations and querying capabilities for notification records.

methods.name: addNotification
methods.description: Creates a new notification in the database and returns its ID.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of an existing notification by its ID.

methods.name: deleteNotification
methods.description: Removes a notification record from the database based on ID.

methods.name: getNotification
methods.description: Retrieves a specific notification record from the database by ID.

methods.name: getNotifications
methods.description: Fetches a list of notifications based on optional filtering criteria such as status, start index, and limit.

methods.name: getTotalNotifications
methods.description: Returns the total count of notification records in the database, optionally filtered by conditions.
